summary: Frontend-only review completed on the public preview across desktop and mobile. Core content, WebGL canvas, manifesto chapters, marquees, all four project images, contact validation/success behavior, and error-free console execution were verified. Major failures remain in runtime performance and navigation: measured hero animation was ~1.65 FPS, preloaders took 10.83-13.77s instead of ~3.75s total, all four mobile menu links failed to scroll, masked section headlines remained hidden after nav jumps, and Back to top was still at scrollY 1946 after 4s.

ui_bugs.issue: Severe main-thread/render starvation: a 3-second requestAnimationFrame sample produced only 6 frames (~1.65 FPS). Three completed fresh-load measurements detached the preloader only after 10.83s, 13.05s, and 13.77s; another mobile attempt was still displaying 100 when the 5s visibility wait timed out. The loader eventually detached in completed runs but is far slower and less reliable than the intended ~3.75s including exit animation.
All mobile links close the drawer but do not navigate. nav-mobile-work/about/skills/contact each left window.scrollY at 0; target tops remained 3059.25, 844, 2427.25, and 5999.5 respectively.

Programmatic scrolling is not smoothly integrated with Lenis. Desktop nav often generated only two near-final scroll positions (for WORK: 3323 and 3381), effectively jumping. Footer Back to top remained at scrollY 1946 after 4 seconds from 7190.

After navbar navigation, About and Contact masked headlines remain translated out of their clipping containers and visually absent. About inner headline spans still had transform matrix(..., 0, 66) after 2.2s, matching the large blank headline area seen in the rendered section.

integration_issues.flow: Lenis smooth scrolling with navbar and footer controls
integration_issues.issue: Navbar and footer use native scrollIntoView/window.scrollTo instead of the active Lenis instance; mobile scrolling is canceled entirely and desktop scrolling is inconsistent/sluggish under the continuously rendered WebGL scene.

issues: Muted #52525b text on #050505/#0a0a0a is below normal-text contrast guidance and is frequently used at only 10-12px for labels/meta.
Awwwards-style motion is not perceptibly smooth in the tested public environment because the hero measured ~1.65 FPS.

action_items: Gate/defer Hero3D creation until the preloader exits; reduce geometry/DPR workload and pause or unmount the Canvas while offscreen. Re-profile until preload timing and rAF responsiveness are acceptable.
Use the Lenis instance scrollTo API for desktop/mobile nav and Back to top; close the mobile drawer without canceling the target scroll.
Ensure MaskReveal whileInView animations activate after programmatic navigation and under realistic frame load; section headlines must not remain clipped.
Increase contrast of #52525b small labels/meta against the dark backgrounds.
Retest preloader timing, all mobile links, masked headings, smooth scrolling, and footer after performance fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js mounts Hero3D immediately behind the preloader and passes an empty Preloader onComplete callback, so expensive WebGL initialization competes with and delays the rAF-based counter.
Hero3D uses detail=6, DPR up to 2, MeshDistortMaterial, environment lighting, and an always-running Canvas even when the hero is offscreen; measured output was ~1.65 FPS.
Navbar and Footer bypass ReactLenis with native scrollIntoView/window.scrollTo, producing canceled mobile navigation and inconsistent desktop animation.
Preloader schedules a completion setTimeout without retaining/clearing it during effect cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend intentionally skipped. Verified: active WebGL context with no JS/WebGL console errors; About chapters 01/02/03; animated skills marquee; project-001..004 metadata and loaded natural image dimensions; empty contact error toast; valid contact success toast insertion, field clearing, and zero mutation requests; mobile layout has no horizontal overflow. Contact success was captured immediately with MutationObserver because severe frame starvation can make the default toast disappear before delayed automation assertions. Reproduce mobile nav at 390x844: every mobile link closes but scrollY stays 0.
rca_of_the_issue: Primary RCA is continuous, expensive WebGL rendering starting concurrently with the preloader: App does not gate Hero3D on preload completion, while the Canvas runs detail-6 distorted geometry at high DPR and remains active offscreen. This starves rAF, observers, timers, toast visibility, and scroll animations. Navigation additionally invokes native browser scrolling while ReactLenis owns smooth scrolling; collapsing the animated mobile menu cancels those native scroll requests.
